race.comment: ACTION KING (5) has returned in career-best touch this prep, following his narrow defeat first-up at Eagle Farm with an arrogant win here on the Acton last month. Was far from disgraced in town last time and sets up a treat for this. Will just be sweating on a gap. VELLA'S BEST (2) brings the sharper winning form, having led and fought off Rantan in a BM72 on the Kenso last month. Is unbeaten over this track and trip and is sure to get every chance in front again. WHO BUT ROO (3) dominated his rivals here three back on the Acton before heading to town where it was a bit too rich for him. Tried hard under the big weight here two weeks ago but it took its toll. Gets weight relief and drops back to a trip he loves. Some hope for the old boy. MY LAST HOORAY (7) had a first-up excuse at Queanbeyan after racing wide, and the weight drop gives him a better platform second-up. Distance specialist who is in the mix. FINE VINTAGE (1) carries the big weight but has to be included.
